messages:
sam.engineering: Heads up — after upgrading to our TS SDK v1.2.4 a bunch of customers are hitting 404s and 400s when calling model listing and generation endpoints. Repro below.

sam.engineering: node server logs: 
```
Error: Request failed with status code 404
    at createError (node_modules/axios/lib/core/createError.js:16:15)
    at settle (node_modules/axios/lib/core/settle.js:17:12)
    at IncomingMessage.handleStreamEnd (node_modules/axios/lib/adapters/http.js:297:11)
```

sam.engineering: sample client code (TS):
```
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood-inference/sdk';
const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await c.models.list(); // used to work
```

maria.support: Can you paste the SDK version and a curl that reproduces? Also is this hosted or dedicated customer?

sam.engineering: SDK in package.json: "@redwood-inference/sdk": "1.2.4". Customer is hosted (prod us-west). Curl that fails: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" https://api.redwood.com/v1/models/list
# -> 404 Not Found
```

ryan.eng: This looks like the v1.3 API change — we renamed/namespace-shifted model endpoints to /v1/catalog/models and also renamed some params (model -> model_id). SDK v1.2.x still calls the old routes. I think the hosted API started deprecating the old paths and 1.3 became default for new tenants last week. :grimacing:

sam.engineering: Ugh. Customer was on autopilot and hit new default. They have pinned our SDK in their lockfile and can't upgrade quickly. Any hotfix?

alex.platform: Two quick workarounds: 1) temporary direct curl to new endpoint from their app (bypass SDK) until they can upgrade; 2) patch their node_modules to change the path mapping (quick but fragile). Better: we can enable the old compatibility route for their tenant — escalating to infra.

maria.support: For triage, can you repro a 400 where generation body param names differ? Sam, any example of the 400?

sam.engineering: Yes — when they call createCompletion the SDK sends body { model: "rw-v1" , prompt: "hi" } and our API now expects { model_id: "rw-v1", input: "hi" } -> 400: 
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{"error":"unknown parameter 'model'","code":400}
```

ryan.eng: Confirmed. The mapping changed in API v1.3. SDK v1.3.0 includes named param translations and endpoint routes. Long term we need to coordinate default API version bump and SDK pinning notices.

maria.support: Action items: 1) Sam — share customer package-lock and quick repro (you did, thanks). 2) I'll open an internal incident and notify eng-oncall. 3) Ryan/Alex — can infra re-enable compatibility routes for tenant ID t-83f until they upgrade? Tagging eng-oncall.

dev-bot: Incident created: INC-4521 (auto) — assigned to eng-oncall.

ryan.eng: Short-term workaround for the customer: call the new endpoints directly with curl / regular fetch. Example conversion: 
```
POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/catalog/models/generate
Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY
Content-Type: application/json
{ "model_id": "rw-v1", "input": "hi" }
```

sam.engineering: Putting that in the customer ticket. Also giving them a single-file shim they can drop in while they upgrade: 
```
// shim-client.js
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
module.exports.listModels = (key) => fetch('https://api.redwood.com/v1/catalog/models', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${key}` } }).then(r=>r.json());
```

alex.platform: I'll loop in infra. If we re-enable compatibility, add a short TTL and log the tenants using it so we can notify them to upgrade.

maria.support: Thanks team. Sam — please attach the customer's lockfile and the exact error payload to INC-4521. I'll update the customer with the curl workaround and ETA. :thumbsup:
